timeline.description: Safari 录屏展示 ChatGPT 网页，右下角固定画中画显示 Andrej Karpathy 在室内讲解并配合手势。网页从起始页进入新对话，随后切换到较早的历史会话。
Andrej Karpathy 在右下角画中画中向镜头挥手致意。
Andrej Karpathy 开场介绍 ChatGPT 已广受关注，并概括其通过文本任务与 AI 交互的方式。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Hi everyone. So by now you have probably heard of ChatGPT. It has taken the world and the AI community by storm, and it is a system that allows you to interact with an AI and give it text-based tasks.

timeline.description: chat.openai.com 的 ChatGPT 起始页显示示例、能力和限制三栏内容。
他以让 ChatGPT 写一首关于理解 AI、改善世界并促进繁荣的俳句为例，说明文本提示的使用。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So for example, we can ask ChatGPT to write us a small haiku about how important it is that people understand AI, and that they can use it to improve the world and make it more prosperous.

timeline.description: 他在底部输入框中输入俳句提示词，随后提交，页面切换为新对话视图。
提交提示后，他读出 ChatGPT 正在生成的第一首俳句。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So when we run this, AI knowledge brings prosperity for all to see, embrace its power.

timeline.description: ChatGPT 逐词生成并完整显示第一首三行俳句，之后该结果一直保留在当前会话页面。
timeline.text:
AI knowledge brings
Prosperity for all to see
Embrace its power

timeline.description: 他评价生成结果不错，并指出 ChatGPT 的文字是从左到右按顺序逐步生成的。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Okay, not bad. And so you could see that ChatGPT went from left to right and generated all these words sort of sequentially.

timeline.description: Andrej Karpathy 看着第一首俳句的生成结果露出笑容，随后短暂发笑。
他说明较早曾对完全相同的提示词得到略有不同的结果，并读出另一首俳句进行比较。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: Now, I asked it already the exact same prompt a little bit earlier, and it generated a slightly different outcome. AI's power to grow. Ignorance holds us back, learn. Prosperity waits.

timeline.description: 他点击左侧历史会话“AI's Power Prosperity”，调出此前针对同一提示词生成的另一首俳句。
较早会话中显示同一提示词的另一版三行俳句，与刚刚生成的结果措辞不同。
timeline.text:
AI's power to grow
Ignorance holds us back, learn
Prosperity waits

timeline.description: 他比较两次生成结果，解释 ChatGPT 是概率系统，同一提示词可以产生多个不同回答。
timeline.speaker: Andrej Karpathy

text_variants.text: So pretty good in both cases and slightly different. So you can see that ChatGPT is a probabilistic system, and for any one prompt, it can give us multiple answers sort of replying to it.
